The '''Joxin system''',<ref name="TF" /> also referred to as the '''Endregaad system''',<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Indrexu sector/Legends|Indrexu sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained a yellow [[Star/Legends|star]] and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]].<ref name="Scourge" />
